issues.requirement_quote: The orthogonal regions of the active mode of collision avoidance allow for concurrent activation different of collision avoidance controls.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PlantUML source defines three named region composites under ActiveState with initial pseudostates to BrakingControl, SteeringControl, EmergencyStop, suggesting author intent for regions.
issues.title: Active mode lacks orthogonal region structure
